title: merge-pipeline workflow
description: A merge-pipeline workflow file: an ordered list of branch patterns, each merged into the next.

$schema.title: Schema reference
$schema.description: Lets editors validate this file. Point it at the published schema URL.

disabled.title: Disable this workflow
disabled.description: A disabled workflow is loaded but never offered for selection.

name.title: Workflow name
name.description: Shown when selecting a workflow and accepted by --workflow.

order.title: Order number
order.description: Lower numbers are shown first when selecting workflows

pipeline.title: The pipeline to run
pipeline.description: Branch patterns, each merged into the next. Every entry is a case-insensitive regular expression matched against local branch names.

items.title: Branch pattern
items.description: Regular expression used to find the branch

conflictCommand.title: Conflict command
conflictCommand.description: Shell command offered when a merge stops on conflicts (for example a code generator that rebuilds generated files). If it leaves no conflicts, the merge is committed with --no-verify and the run continues.

conflictNoVerify.title: Commit the conflict-command merge with --no-verify
conflictNoVerify.description: Only used with conflictCommand. When true (the default) the merge commit skips git hooks.

conflictFiles.title: Paths the conflict command applies to
conflictFiles.description: Only used with conflictCommand. Regular expressions searched against conflicted file paths; the command is offered only when at least one conflicted path matches. Omit to offer it for any conflict.
